pages.title: d01.txt
pages.text: Residents may keep domestic animals only with prior written consent from the property manager. Any damage to the carpets must be paid for by the tenant. Reference TEN-49271.

pages.title: d02.txt
pages.text: Bring the damaged product and purchase receipt to the service desk within thirty days. Staff can exchange it or return the payment to the original card. Reference RET-81342.

pages.title: d03.txt
pages.text: The camera stores photographs on a removable memory card. Before erasing the card, copy the pictures to a second drive and verify that the copies open. Reference CAM-25816.

pages.title: d04.txt
pages.text: For a declined transaction, telephone the card issuer to check the spending limit and whether the account has been temporarily blocked. Never send your PIN to the shop. Reference PAY-70193.

pages.title: d05.txt
pages.text: A two-day workshop begins at nine on Monday in the east hall. Participants should bring a charged laptop. The afternoon session covers repairing bicycle punctures. Reference EVT-61427.

pages.title: d06.txt
pages.text: To protect tomato seedlings during a cold night, drape fabric over the plants before sunset. Remove the covering the next morning. Avoid sealing wet foliage under plastic. Reference GDN-35082.

pages.title: d07.txt
pages.text: The wireless router has no lights after a power interruption. Check the wall outlet, reconnect its power adapter, and wait two minutes before testing internet access. Reference NET-98614.

pages.title: d08.txt
pages.text: Combine oats with milk in a jar and leave it in the refrigerator overnight. Add berries just before eating. This breakfast requires no cooking in the morning. Reference FOD-12745.

pages.title: d09.txt
pages.text: Residents may keep bicycles in the basement rack. Do not leave them in corridors because the routes must stay clear for evacuation.

pages.title: d10.txt
pages.text: The shop offers a repair estimate for products purchased more than thirty days ago. An estimate does not authorize the repair; the customer must agree to the quoted cost.

pages.title: d11.txt
pages.text: The camera battery should be charged with the supplied adapter. A blinking orange indicator means charging is underway, and a green indicator means it has finished.

pages.title: d12.txt
pages.text: A merchant may refund a canceled order. Allow several business days for the credit to appear on the card statement; contact the shop with the order number if it does not arrive.

pages.title: d13.txt
pages.text: The cycling workshop was held last year in the west hall. The topic was adjusting gears, and attendees did not need a computer.

pages.title: d14.txt
pages.text: Tomato plants need steady moisture during hot weather. Water the soil early and avoid wetting leaves in bright sunlight.

pages.title: d15.txt
pages.text: A router with a flashing red internet light has power but cannot connect to the provider. Check the network cable and the provider outage notice.

pages.title: d16.txt
pages.text: To bake oat biscuits, mix oats with butter and flour, shape small rounds and place them in a hot oven until golden.
